generatedProse.practice-connection:
Everything in this course is about presenting work you will actually do. In many modules you are asked to present: a piece of reading in a seminar, a poster at a conference-style session, or a group project to the rest of the class. Treat what follows as being about your own presentations, not about presenting in the abstract.

The same skill reaches past your degree. Wherever people share findings or make a case to an audience, the ones who communicate clearly are the ones who are heard. Learning to present well now is practice for that.
